name: Personalized Learning Path Generator
description: Collects a learner's goals, current skill level, and preferred learning style via a form, then queries the course knowledge base using RAG to find relevant materials. An LLM assembles a structured learning path with milestones, which is parsed and stored in the database. A recurring schedule sends weekly progress check-in reminders. Built for EdTech platforms and corporate training departments delivering adaptive learning experiences.

data.label: Learner submits goals and skill assessment

fields.name: learningGoal
fields.label: What do you want to learn?

data.label: Search course catalog for relevant materials
Generate structured learning path with milestones

config.prompt:
You are an expert learning path designer.

Create a personalized learning path for this learner:
- Goal: {{learningGoal}}
- Current Level: {{currentLevel}}
- Preferred Style: {{learningStyle}}
- Available Time: {{weeklyHours}} hours/week

Available course materials:
{{ragResults}}

Create a structured learning path with:
1. 4-8 sequential milestones, each with a title, description, and estimated weeks
2. Specific course/resource recommendations for each milestone
3. Practice exercises or projects per milestone
4. Assessment criteria for milestone completion

Output as JSON with keys: pathTitle, totalWeeks, milestones (array of {title, description, weeks, resources, exercises, assessmentCriteria})

config.query: INSERT INTO learning_paths (learner_id, title, total_weeks, milestones_json, learning_style, weekly_hours, status, created_at) VALUES ('{{learnerId}}', '{{pathTitle}}', {{totalWeeks}}, '{{milestonesJson}}', '{{learningStyle}}', {{weeklyHours}}, 'active', NOW()) RETURNING id

data.label: Create milestone records for each milestone

body.query: INSERT INTO milestones (learning_path_id, title, description, week_number, resources, exercises, status) VALUES ({{learningPathId}}, '{{milestone.title}}', '{{milestone.description}}', {{milestone.weeks}}, '{{milestone.resources}}', '{{milestone.exercises}}', 'pending')

data.label: Send learning path and weekly reminders

config.subject: Your Personalized Learning Path: {{pathTitle}}
